name: Quantum
summary: The current shelf separates final 2024 PQC standards, the 2025 HQC backup-algorithm selection, preliminary credential specifications, and federal migration planning. It supports standards and selection milestones while implementation, validation, procurement, inventory, and completed migration remain downstream. Phase 65 adds a four-record reporting shelf and the Published briefing “Frontier Topic 003: Quantum Readiness Runs Through Migration,” with explicit authority, implementation, acceptance, operating, and outcome boundaries.
watch_questions: When does the selected HQC algorithm become a draft, final standard, validated implementation, protocol option, and supported product?
Which institutions have cryptographic inventories, risk priorities, procurement language, vendor commitments, pilots, and completed migration milestones?
Which quantum-computing and sensing claims remain laboratory evidence, and which produce validated infrastructure or operational obligations?
Phase 65: Which records separate quantum research and migration policy from standards, procurement, tested interoperability, accepted cutover, and retired cryptography?
